mobbin:0a0113c1-6c8a-4764-a2b7-938abacee.summary: User works through Getting Started checklists, opens Home, and lands on a Welcome home / personalised home with recents, My tasks, empty Suggested/Trending, templates and Learn cards.
steps: Home tooltip on sidebar Home item
Welcome home: recents + My tasks + Suggested
steal: Steps 0–1: First-run as a live checklist page in the workspace (invite teammates, add teamspaces) rather than a modal-only tour.
Steps 3–7: Recently visited cards as jump-back into work already started.
Steps 4–5: Explicit empty copy for Suggested/Trending (“Pages relevant to you will show up here”) instead of blank panels.
Steps 6–7: My tasks row with due date, status pill (In progress / Not started), and source tag — scannable “what needs me.”
avoid: No widget add/remove/reorder UI appears — tagging widgets overstates customisation; the home is a fixed stack of sections.
mobbin:0a0113c1-6c8a-4764-a2b7-938abacee.fit: Dashboard-only home pattern: recents + My tasks replace tile sprawl; tasks hand off to Debrief/Courses for grading and to Scheduling for due sessions; Featured templates/Learn map to first-run for a new center, not a Reports KPI wall.

mobbin:cb1f904a-8674-4b22-8793-bd431804a.summary: From a Welcome checklist the user reaches Home with ask/search, Upcoming events for today/tomorrow, and a My tasks list where one task is checked complete.
steps: Home: ask bar, recents, Upcoming events, My tasks
Home focused on Upcoming events + tasks (one done)
steal: Step 1: Upcoming events grouped by day (“Today July 11”, next day) above the task list — agenda without a full calendar module.
Step 2: Checkbox complete state on My tasks (Landing page checked) with due dates and project tag kept visible.
Step 1: Home combines recents + agenda + tasks in one scroll; New task sits on the list itself.
mobbin:cb1f904a-8674-4b22-8793-bd431804a.fit: Dashboard Today strip fed by Scheduling (sessions by time/room) with task checkboxes for faculty action items that open Debrief or Courses; lives on the dashboard, not a separate calendar page.

mobbin:2abedcd0-4648-4c73-be51-6dd1763ed.summary: Private workspace shows Welcome checklist and full sidebar (Recents, Agents, Teamspaces, Notion Apps), then a trial unlock modal over the same page, then the page alone again.
steps: Trial unlock modal over Welcome page
steal: Step 0: Sidebar exposes Home/Search/Inbox, Recents, companion apps (Mail/Calendar), My Tasks, and New page/chat — module nav + quick-create in one rail.
Step 0: Trial “30 days left” badge in the nav for time-boxed setup urgency.
Step 1: Overlay trial checklist with locked reward step — optional layer on top of the in-page guide.
avoid: Step 1 gamified “unlock a rare accessory” trial modal is noise for a clinical ops dashboard.
mobbin:2abedcd0-4648-4c73-be51-6dd1763ed.fit: Sidebar pattern for Essentials module navigation (Recording, Scheduling, Reports, etc.) plus dashboard-only Welcome checklist; companion-app links resemble handoffs to Calendar/Scheduling rather than widgets.
